note: GLOBALCIT's Citizenship Law Dataset v3.0 (EUI, 2025), coding the law in force on 1 January 2024 (A06a KYR 13, 16; A06b KYR 13, 16; L05 KYR 26): ordinary naturalisation after 5 years' residence; no renunciation of other citizenships required; a citizen keeps it on taking another. Reforms after that date are checked in the file's later sources, where a later source is given.

sources.title: GLOBALCIT Citizenship Law Dataset v3.0 (Vink, van der Baaren, Bauböck, Dzankic, Honohan, Manby; EUI Research Data, 2025), country-year-mode files, Kyrgyzstan, 2024
sources.said: Person has had 5 years of continuous and uninterrupted residence in the country. ... n.a. ... Person acquires citizenship of States bordering Kyrgyzstan (Kazakhstan, Uzbekistan, Tajikistan and China).
